{{Quote|They're executing King Dendup tomorrow in Yolahn Square.|[[Dono (Onderonian)/Legends|Dono]]|<ref name="The Soft War">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref>}}
'''Yolahn Square''' was an area in the middle of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was located at the foot of the [[Unifar Temple/Legends|Unifar Temple]], the residence of Onderon's [[King/Legends|king]].

==History==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], under the reign of [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], the planned [[Attempted execution of Ramsis Dendup and Saw Gerrera/Legends|execution]] of previous king [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] took place there. Sometime after the failed execution and the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]]' final victory against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] in the [[Onderon highlands/Legends|eastern highlands]], a [[Funeral of Steela Gerrera/Legends|funeral]] for [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] was held at this square.
